# Atlas Design System

<!-- design-md:section experience -->
## 1. Experience

<!-- design-md:claim scope kind=product-surface lang=en -->
### Scope

Atlas helps dispatchers resolve exceptions while preserving shipment identity and ownership.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->

<!-- design-md:claim primary-tasks kind=user-outcomes count=1 lang=en -->
### Primary tasks

- Resolve a shipment exception while preserving identity and ownership.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->

<!-- design-md:section foundations -->
## 2. Foundations

<!-- design-md:claim foundations kind=rules-or-constraints lang=en -->
Blue is reserved for actions. Borders separate evidence without decorative elevation.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->

<!-- design-md:section typography-assets -->
## 3. Typography & Assets

Use the project-owned UI family. Omit an asset whose authority is unresolved.

<!-- design-md:section components-states -->
## 4. Components & States

Assignment controls retain shipment identity through default, focus, error, and success states.

<!-- design-md:section layout-platforms -->
## 5. Layout & Platforms

At narrow widths, evidence precedes the assignment action and no content clips.

<!-- design-md:section content-locales -->
## 6. Content & Locales

Labels are concrete and adapted independently for each supported locale.

<!-- design-md:section governance -->
## 7. Governance

<!-- design-md:claim authority kind=project-system lang=en -->
### Authority

This document is the project design contract for the declared scope.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->

<!-- design-md:claim application-priority order=prompt-fact,repository-fact,system-contract,reference-inspiration lang=en -->
### Application priority

1. Direct user instructions for the requested scope.
2. Repository facts.
3. This system contract.
4. Reference inspiration.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->

<!-- design-md:claim unknowns policy=absent-at-smallest-unresolved-boundary lang=en -->
### Unknowns

Omit only the smallest unresolved value or group. Do not replace it with a plausible default.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->

<!-- design-md:claim changes policy=review-record-validate-before-adoption lang=en -->
### Changes

Record, review, and validate changes before adoption.
<!-- design-md:claim-end -->
